craft_notes: Sthāyin: food-Mother. Sanskrit-first: annamayī kept. Rows: 2. Close: light. Rejected: disgust — killed: śakti. Read aloud: bathing cadence.

lines: Meal as Mother, bathe the dead.
l4.sanskrit_cite: gururannamayīṃ śaktiṃ vṛṃhikāṃ vīryarūpiṇīm | dhyātvā tayā samāviṣṭaṃ taṃ sādhyaṃ cintayetsudhīḥ
